title: Should you tailor your resume? ✍️
description:
Do you need to tailor your resume for every job you apply for? Short answer, no. Unless you're applying to vastly different types of roles and are clearly qualified for all. Long answer, you should be carefully reading each job you apply for. Is one role looking for someone with a key program knowledge? Maybe highlight that a bit more in your resume application. Overall, you don't need to overhaul your resume completely for every role you apply for, your experience and hard skills should speak for themselves, but you want to ensure your skillset aligns with the specific role you're applying for. #resume #resumetips #resumetip #resumebuilder
